name: react-compat-shim
comment: preact is declared, and pinned exact, on purpose. Without it this package resolved preact by walking up into pnpm's hidden hoist directory (node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules), whose contents depend on install history: a clean install put 10.28.3 there while this workspace renders with 10.25.4, which is two preact instances and every hook throwing on __H. Exact so a caret can never drift the shim off the version the harness renders with.
